description:
## Objective

Encode the repository quality definition as a validated contract.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U21`
Covers: `R11`, `R13`, `R15`, `R17` through `R22`; `KTD9`, `KTD12`, `KTD16`, `KTD17`

The repository has focused suites and a package coverage threshold. It does not have one machine-readable quality definition. This task creates that definition before remaining suite imports continue.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: `jido-07x.1` for the source manifest and runners; `jido-07x.2` for authoring and Covenant aliases.
- Unblocks: `jido-07x.22` for component proof mapping.

## Branch and integration rule

- Base: `main` at or after `40fee8aced404aa29dc5cd7461babbd8679386b6`.
- Combine: Execute directly on `main` per KTD16. Do not create a branch, worktree, or pull request.

## Source inventory

- `test/quality/source_manifest.yml` — one existing source ledger to preserve.
- `mix.exs` — one existing focused-alias register to bind into the contract.
- `test/test_helper.exs` — one existing special-tag exclusion list to validate.

## API and behavior map

- Suite-local aliases -> quality-contract suite records. Evidence: `mix.exs`.
- Package coverage threshold -> contract-owned package threshold. Evidence: `mix.exs`.
- Property and fuzz report rules -> contract-owned evidence requirements. Evidence: `test/property/**/support/report.exs`.

## Files

- Read: `mix.exs`, `test/test_helper.exs`, `test/quality/source_manifest.yml`, `test/property/**/support/report.exs`
- Change: `mix.exs`, `test/quality/README.md`
- Add: `test/quality/quality_contract.yml`, `test/quality/quality_contract_test.exs`
- Do not change: `lib/**`, `../refs/**`, public runtime behavior
- Expected shared changes: None

## Instructions

1. Add the quality-contract schema for suites, thresholds, waivers, reports, and stability findings.
2. Record every required and opt-in suite with its focused alias and evidence artifact.
3. Reject missing fields, duplicate IDs, invalid thresholds, expired waivers, and paths outside the repository.
4. Add a focused contract-validation alias and document it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A valid contract passes with seed `0`.
- [ ] A package threshold below 90 or component threshold below 80 fails.
- [ ] A missing required suite or duplicate suite ID fails with the affected ID.
- [ ] A waiver without owner, reason, and expiry condition fails.
- [ ] No file under `lib/**` or `../refs/**` changes.

## Verification

- `mix test test/quality/quality_contract_test.exs --seed 0` — exits with status `0`.
- `mix format --check-formatted` — exits with status `0`.
- `git diff --check` — exits with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, contract records, verification results, deviations from the plan, deferred work, and remaining blockers.
title: Encode the objective quality contract
